title: BPW-2026-0514
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0514
STOP NOTICE – ZEFIRO CORPORATION
Zefiro Corporation, is transmitting a Stop Notice in the amount of $234,102.76, for labor and drilling equipment for mobilization and drilling of 30-inch diameter cast-in-drilled-hole pile shafts for the north wall and south wall for Jilk Heavy Construction Inc. in connection with the Kinney Street Improvements.
(C-144945, Communication No. 122742 - Filed September 9, 2026)
summary: Stop Notice of $234,102.76 from Zefiro Corporation for drilling equipment and labor for pile shafts for Kinney Street Improvements.
